app: ballroom-quest HEAD efd89c0, backend/main.py via FastAPI TestClient
model: PydanticAI FunctionModel (scripted stand-in; no live LLM, $0)

tests.test: The screen quarantines the attack line
tests.what_we_did: screen_notes() on the app's built-in injection sample (4 lines).
tests.expected: Line 3 flagged and replaced; the 3 dance lines kept.

tests.test: The model never sees the attack line; the drill is still built
tests.what_we_did: POST /api/drill with the same sample; a scripted model records every word it is sent.
tests.expected: HTTP 200, line 3 reported, attack text absent from everything the model received, notes inside <teammate_notes>.

tests.test: Validator sends a made-up figure back (ModelRetry)
tests.what_we_did: Coach answer 1 suggests 'sw_backflip' (not in the syllabus); answer 2 is correct.
tests.expected: Answer 1 rejected with the reason; answer 2 accepted; the player only sees answer 2.

observed.retry_reason: "These ids are not in the syllabus: ['sw_backflip']. Use only syllabus ids."

tests.what_we_did: Coach answer 1 says the broken Natural Turn -> Reverse Turn routine 'flows'.
tests.expected: Rejected because check_routine says needs_fix; corrected answer accepted.

observed.retry_reason: "check_routine says the verdict is 'needs_fix'. Fix the verdict and issues."

tests.test: Persistent bad output: friendly error, no leak, run still logged and charged
tests.what_we_did: Every Coach answer contains a link (3 tries = 1 + 2 retries).
tests.expected: HTTP 502 with a plain message; the link never reaches the player; run logged as error and charged.

observed.message: The AI couldn't produce a valid answer this time. Please try again.

tests.test: A looping agent is stopped at the 8-call limit
tests.what_we_did: The scripted model calls check_routine forever and never answers.
tests.expected: Stopped after 8 model calls; HTTP 502 'hit its step limit'; run logged and charged.

observed.message: The agent hit its step limit before finishing. Try a shorter request.

tests.what_we_did: Session already charged $0.25, then asks the Coach again.
tests.expected: HTTP 429 before any model call; the game keeps working.

observed.message: This session reached its $0.25 AI budget. The game still works; AI coaching is paused.

tests.test: Daily cap: AI pauses for everyone at $3.00
tests.what_we_did: The whole app has spent $3.00 today; a brand-new session asks the Coach.

observed.message: The app reached today's AI budget. The game still works; AI coaching resumes tomorrow.

tests.test: Rate limit: the 21st request in 10 minutes is refused
tests.what_we_did: 21 Coach requests from one session in a row.
tests.expected: Requests 1-20 answered; request 21 gets HTTP 429 without a model call.

observed.message: Slow down: too many AI requests in 10 minutes. Try again shortly.

tests.test: Legality is decided by code, not the model
tests.what_we_did: POST /api/check on Natural Turn -> Reverse Turn, then with RF Closed Change inserted.
tests.expected: Broken chain rejected with the reason; fixed chain accepted; no model call, $0.

observed.broken_problem: After Natural Turn the leader's R foot is free, but Reverse Turn starts with the L foot.
